extraction.name: MVBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive multi-modal video understanding benchmark for evaluating temporal understanding in MLLMs. It covers 20 challenging video tasks that cannot be solved with a single frame and is built by converting public video annotations into multiple-choice QA.
extraction.creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The benchmark was built by selecting videos from 11 existing public video datasets, filtering them for diversity, temporal sensitivity, and question difficulty, and then automatically converting their annotations into multiple-choice QA pairs using LLMs/ChatGPT with limited manual intervention.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw/source data consisted of videos and public video annotations from 11 public benchmarks/datasets, including STAR, PAXION, Moments in Time V1, FunQA, CLEVRER, Perception Test, Charades-STA, MoVQA, NTU RGB+D, VLN-CE, and TVQA.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automatic annotation paradigm that converts open-sourced/public video annotations into multiple-choice QA using LLMs/ChatGPT, guided by temporal task definitions; includes data filtration, question generation, option construction, random sampling/shuffling, and length balancing.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Quality control/validation included filtering for temporal sensitivity and question difficulty, using ground-truth annotations for fairness and accuracy, and enforcing similar option lengths to avoid answer leakage.
extraction.rai:annotationsPerItem: One multiple-choice QA generated per video, with 3 to 5 answer options sampled for each question.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: LLMs, specifically ChatGPT, used to generate questions, convert open-ended QA to multiple-choice QA, and normalize answer option lengths.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The benchmark is designed to reduce evaluation bias from LLM-based scoring by using ground-truth video annotations and automatic QA generation.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Existing benchmarks are limited because they focus mainly on static image spatial understanding, basic video tasks, particular domains, or restricted scenes; additionally, the proposed baseline model struggles on position, count, and character tasks, possibly due to limited instruction-tuning exposure.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is intended as a benchmark for evaluating multimodal large language models on temporal video understanding through multiple-choice QA tasks.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The models and data are publicly available on GitHub.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Automatic generation of multiple-choice question-answer pairs from open-sourced video annotations for evaluation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos were collected and annotated for each task under temporal task definitions.
